data: Synthetic events and isolated temporary storage only
coverage: Recent default, explicit earliest, original timestamps and pagination
Literal topics, multiple terms and empty results without partial-token fallback
Current-user cutoff, invalid dates and historical status
Questions do not become facts; legacy question artifacts do not supersede declarations
Fact filtering before pagination and current-turn exclusion
Owner, framework, platform, bot, group and private scope separation
Structured quote IDs, source attribution, exact original responses and unavailable-source refusal
Ban, recall, media, forward, nested quote and metadata-conflict boundaries
Old storage reload and unchanged original records
SDK reference mappings and botpy empty reference objects
limits: Framework events and AstrBot hooks use fixtures and API stubs, not running framework instances
Outbound bot messages must be submitted by the trusted host before they can be resolved as quote sources
No automatic platform recall subscription or arbitrary model-output guard
AstrBot request-history reset remains; other AI integrations must honor command results and source policy
Strict lexical matching may return fewer candidates for vague queries
